quote: Are we about to do a Kubernetes, or is this genuinely a case where the lighter spool-up saves us maintenance headaches and technical debt?
gloss: Ask this before reaching for heavy infrastructure. Check whether the complexity is actually earning its keep, or whether it's just the familiar-looking choice.
context: Quoted by @nainrouge420.bsky.social as an example of a hard-fought lesson that made it into their agent instructions in the quoter's own words.

quote: Make the agent prove it understands things.
gloss: Don't trust a plausible-sounding plan. Before it acts, get it to demonstrate real comprehension of the constraints — ask it to restate intent, or give it a case where 'sounds right' and 'is right' diverge (their example: asking a model to place text on a book cover reveals whether it actually understands the UVs, or is just guessing).
context: From a post about their number one agent tip, quoted into the same thread by @nainrouge420.bsky.social.
